fit: AB96 paired ground-truth labels only; C labels never an argument to fit_rules
input: current frozen readout probabilities plus declared skill/arguments only
effect_induction: Copy all current facts; collect AB changed predicate roles per action family, overwrite only roles whose post-value is unanimous across all AB examples in that family. Other facts never reset. Conflicting/unsupported effects become UNKNOWN.
target_binding: lift: explicit declaration; place: all three current held facts known and exactly one true; never root mission colour, actual successor or executor outcome
preconditions: No execution applicability rule is imported or inferred from controller. Learned assignments extrapolate the observed successful AB action effects. Only target binding is a prerequisite to role instantiation. This is a simple effect table, not learned failure/refusal dynamics.
unknown: Keep copied UNKNOWN unless an AB-supported assignment determines that fact. Unresolved place target (including known empty hand) makes all possible held/in target effect facts UNKNOWN; open is copied. Unseen action makes all seven UNKNOWN. Reapply multiple-positive-held UNKNOWN rule. No zero-time self-loop is assumed.
evaluation: All original120 pairs retained; C all24/tune12/cal12 reported. UNKNOWN counts as wrong in strict metrics. This design is post hoc because earlier C results were already known.
